title: Mage-Flow model and ComfyUI integration publicly linked
summary: On 2026-07-26, a public The recorded link linked Mage-Flow's Hugging Face model repository and a GitHub repository for ComfyUI integration. The dated link set records that the model resources and a ComfyUI-oriented integration were publicly connected at that time. It does not establish a specific release version, authorship, or technical capabilities.
